benchmark.name: TrpB complete 4-site combinatorial fitness landscape
benchmark.provenance: Johnston et al. 2024; 160,000 experimentally measured 20^4 variants

blind_partition.hidden: all variants at Hamming distance 3 or 4 from wild type
blind_partition.visible: all variants at Hamming distance 0, 1, or 2 from wild type
blind_partition.wild_type: read from landscape_meta.json after preregistration; fitness not used to choose it

candidate_generation.domain: enumerate every Hamming-3 and Hamming-4 combination from the 20 standard residue states at the 4 assayed positions

frozen_models.B2_EXACT_PAIRWISE: B1 + sum exact double-mutant epistatic residuals
frozen_models.B2_GLOBAL_SHRINK: B1 + g * sum exact pair residuals, where g is the mean visible-only mutual-resonance weight across all measured mutation pairs; one global scalar, no pair-specific weighting
frozen_models.B3_RELATIVE_RESONANCE: B1 + sum(pair_residual * sqrt(percentile_from_mutation_A * percentile_from_mutation_B)); percentiles are empirical visible-only residual ranks within each mutation's partner distribution
frozen_models.B5_WARM_DORMANT: same numeric score as B3; WARM iff mean signed resonance contribution > 0; WARM candidates ranked before DORMANT, no deletion

primary_metrics: Top-100 capture/enrichment of true hidden top-1-percent variants
normalized regret of Top-1 selected candidate
rank of the true hidden global optimum
secondary: B3 vs each baseline elite-capture discordance
bootstrap confidence intervals for Spearman differences

strong_confirmation_rule.require: B3 must beat B1, B2_EXACT_PAIRWISE, and B2_GLOBAL_SHRINK on at least 4 of 5 primary metrics; B3 Top-100 enrichment must exceed 10x; true hidden global optimum must rank within Top-100; visible-label shuffle B3 pooled Spearman must be near zero (absolute < 0.05).
